title: Advanced type-level patterns — concept map
intro: Branded and opaque types for nominal safety, recursive types with depth limits, builder pattern typing, readability vs clever types, and comparison to C# source generators.

overviewDiagram.title: Branded type boundary
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart LR
  RAW[raw string] --> F[parseUserId factory]
  F -->|valid| UID[UserId brand]
  F -->|invalid| E[null]
  UID --> API[typed API only]

conceptCards.title: Branded types
conceptCards.summary: Phantom tag prevents swapped strings. Factory validates. Zero runtime cost.

conceptCards.title: Recursive types
conceptCards.summary: JSON tree, nested menus. Compiler depth limits. Prefer interfaces for recursion.
conceptCards.example: type Json = string | number | Json[] | { [k: string]: Json }

conceptCards.title: Builder typing
conceptCards.summary: Progressive required fields via chained generics. Step builder pattern.

conceptCards.title: Type complexity limits
conceptCards.summary: Stop when team cannot read errors. Prefer runtime validation + simple types.

conceptCards.title: vs C# generators
conceptCards.summary: TS brands compile-time. C# records and source generators for nominal runtime types.
